# ColumnConditionalOptions

<link-summary>How the columns are read and which of them are candidates.</link-summary>

<web-summary>ColumnConditionalOptions — How the columns are read and which of them are candidates. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
interface ColumnConditionalOptions
```

`headerColumn` is the one-based column holding the row names. As with `headerRow`, setting it keys each column by those names and keeps the header column itself out of the candidates.

## Examples

### Shape

```javascript
const options = { headerColumn: 1 };
```
